title: Android Gradle build fails with "Could not determine the dependencies of task ':compileInstrumentedDebugJavaWithJavac'."
body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.6.stable, also reproduced with Godot 4.5.1

Android SDK is installed using `./sdkmanager --sdk_root="sdk/" "platform-tools" "build-tools;35.0.1" "platforms;android-35" "cmdline-tools;latest" "cmake;3.10.2.4988404" "ndk;28.1.13356709"` (which is found in Godot's docs) and JDK is `temurin-17.jdk`



### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - macOS Monterey (12.6.3) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Intel(R) Iris(TM) Graphics 6100 - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-5557U CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 16.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

Build fails with this output:

```
> Configure project :
WARNING: The option setting 'android.overridePathCheck=true' is experimental.
The current default is 'false'.

FAILURE: Build failed with an exception.

* What went wrong:
Could not determine the dependencies of task ':compileStandardDebugJavaWithJavac'.
> Cannot query the value of this provider because it has no value available.

* Try:
> Run with --stacktrace option to get the stack trace.
> Run with --info or --debug option to get more log output.
> Run with --scan to get full insights.
> Get more help at https://help.gradle.org.

BUILD FAILED in 1s

Exit Code: 1
```

### Steps to reproduce

Steps to reproduce:
- Create new Godot project with "Compatibility" renderer
- Set JDK and Android SDK path in preferences
- Create a UI scene
- "Install Android build package..."
- Add Android as a export target
- Check "Use Gradle Build"
- Run the export

Note that building without Gradle works fine.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

See steps to reproduce
